Job Title: NATURAL GAS & NGL VALUE CHAIN 
 Domain : Oil & Gas - Downstream & Midstream 
 ROLE OVERVIEW 
We are seeking a seasoned Consultant with deep expertise in natural gas and natural gas liquids (NGL) operations to partner with our clients on defining and executing value chain optimization strategies. The successful candidate will combine strong operational knowledge of gas handling and processing with advanced digital transformation capabilities translating complex operational realities into actionable strategic roadmaps, identifying digital gaps across the value chain, and delivering measurable commercial outcomes. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Strategic Vision & Initiative Roadmap 
 Define and articulate the strategic vision for value chain optimization aligned to the client's commercial and operational objectives. Develop a prioritized initiative roadmap spanning short-, medium-, and long-term horizons, covering upstream supply, midstream processing, and downstream distribution of natural gas and NGLs. Identify, scope, and champion quick winshigh-impact, low-effort opportunities that generate immediate value and build stakeholder confidence. Facilitate executive workshops and strategic alignment sessions to gain buy-in across operations, finance, IT, and commercial functions. Translate strategic ambitions into clear business cases with quantified value potential (cost reduction, margin improvement, throughput optimization).
 
 2. Value Chain Assessment & Optimization 
 Conduct end-to-end value chain analysis encompassing gas gathering, compression, treating & sweetening, fractionation, storage, transportation, and marketing. Assess NGL value chains including ethane, propane, butane, and natural gasoline streamsfrom separation and stabilization through to product delivery and offtake. Identify value leakage points, operational inefficiencies, scheduling bottlenecks, and commercial misalignments across the value chain. Benchmark client performance against industry best practices and recommend targeted interventions to close performance gaps. Model alternative value chain configurations and commercial structures (e.g., tolling vs. equity, spot vs. term) to maximize netback and margin capture.
 
 3. Systems & Data Landscape Assessment 
 Perform a structured assessment of the client's current technology landscapeincluding SCADA, DCS, ERP, scheduling, nomination, and measurement systems. Map data flows across the value chain, identifying data silos, manual handoffs, reporting gaps, and integration failures ("digital breaks"). Evaluate data quality, availability, and timeliness for operational decision-making, commercial settlement, and regulatory compliance. Develop a systems capability heat map and gap analysis to frame the digitalization opportunity. Review master data management (MDM) practices and data governance maturity in the context of gas measurement, allocation, and balancing.
 
 4. Digitalization Roadmap & Quick Wins 
 Identify and prioritize digitalization opportunitiesfrom process automation and real-time monitoring to advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and integrated planning tools. Define digital quick wins: automation of manual workflows, dashboard consolidation, IoT-enabled measurement upgrades, or improved scheduling visibility. Develop a phased digitalization roadmap with clear milestones, technology recommendations, resource requirements, and expected ROI. Advise on fit-for-purpose technology choices (e.g., gas nomination platforms, production allocation software, digital twin capabilities, cloud-based optimization tools). Collaborate with IT and OT teams to assess integration architecture and propose practical pathways from current to target-state digital infrastructure. 
 5. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Delivery 
 Build trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders at operational, commercial, and executive levels. Lead and contribute to project workstreams, ensuring deliverables are on time, on budget, and meet quality standards. Prepare and present high-quality findings, recommendations, and roadmaps through client-ready reports and executive briefings. Support change management by coaching client teams through new processes, tools, and operating models. Participate in business development activities including proposal development, client scoping discussions, and practice thought leadership.
 
 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE: 
Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 Demonstrated expertise across the natural gas value chain: gathering, compression, processing, fractionation, storage, transportation, and marketing.
 Strong working knowledge of NGL products (ethane, propane, butanes, pentanes+), their processing requirements, quality specifications, and market dynamics.
 Proven track record in supply chain and/or value chain analysis, optimization, or transformation projects.
 Experience conducting digital maturity assessments, systems landscape reviews, or operational technology (OT/IT) integration projects.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficient in quantitative modeling and data analysis tools.
 Excellent communication and facilitation skills; ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
 
 Preferred : 
MBA or advanced degree in Business, Strategy, or a related field.
Experience with gas scheduling, nomination, and balancing systems (e.g., Quorum, WinTrak, OpenTicket, or equivalent). 
Familiarity with digital transformation frameworks and methodologies (agile, design thinking, lean). 
Exposure to AI/ML applications in production optimization, demand forecasting, or anomaly detection within upstream/midstream gas operations.

 Knowledge of regulatory frameworks governing natural gas pipelines, tariffs, and NGL transportation (FERC, state/provincial regimes).
 
 CORE COMPETENCIES: 
 
NG & NGL Operations Value Chain, Optimization Strategic Roadmapping, Digital Transformation, Systems & Data Assessment, Stakeholder Management Commercial, Acumen Data Analytics, Executive Communication

description:
Business Analyst
As the **Business Analyst – eCommerce**, you will play a key role in driving solution\-oriented changes across the Commercial Department and improving the overall efficiency of the eCommerce domain. You will be responsible for researching, analyzing, and developing data\-driven business cases that support process optimization, cost reduction, new business opportunities, and strategic improvements.

  

You will work closely with the Manager Commercial Projects, Lead Product Owner, Project Managers, Product Owners, and cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Content, B2B, Sales Channels, and Customer Service. You will translate business needs and opportunities into well\-defined business cases, including scope, solution options, expected impact, resource requirements, and budget considerations, enabling effective decision\-making and implementation.

 **You will:**

* **Business Case Development:** Research, analyze, and prepare solution\-oriented business cases for new initiatives, process improvements, eCommerce enhancements, and strategic changes.
* **eCommerce Optimization:** Identify opportunities to improve eCommerce efficiency through process optimization, cost reduction, technology enhancements, and identification of new business opportunities.
* **Market \& Competitor Research:** Conduct market research using available tools and resources to assess new features, industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor approaches.
* **Data Analysis:** Gather and analyze relevant business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, challenges, and potential solutions that support informed decision\-making.
* **Solution Identification:** Evaluate existing eCommerce technology platforms, applications, and emerging technologies to determine potential solutions and expected business outcomes.
* **Innovative Solutions:** Develop innovative solutions for operational and strategic improvements and identify the processes, systems, and capabilities required to implement proposed changes.
* **Requirements Management:** Work closely with business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to understand, document, analyze, and validate critical business requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Align and communicate new ideas, business cases, recommendations, expected benefits, risks, and potential impacts with stakeholders and senior management.
* **Business Case Communication:** Prepare reports, presentations, and business case documentation that clearly communicate proposed changes, solution options, expected outcomes, costs, risks, and business impact.
* **Performance \& Impact Assessment:** Forecast the potential impact of proposed solutions and provide regular reporting on business cases, initiatives, and project performance.
* **Project Assessment:** Conduct critical and efficient assessments of eCommerce projects to evaluate their effectiveness, business value, performance, and alignment with organizational objectives.
* **Product Owner Alignment:** Collaborate with Product Owners to assess and align the development resources, capabilities, and priorities required to deliver each proposed solution.
* **Scope \& Planning:** Define project scope, support workforce planning, forecast budgets, and assess and manage change requests associated with business cases and initiatives.
* **Testing \& Validation:** Conduct or coordinate tests, surveys, workshops, and other validation activities to assess proposed solutions and gather stakeholder feedback.
* **Decision Support:** Evaluate inputs from multiple stakeholders, analyze business situations, identify potential alternatives, and recommend the most appropriate course of action.
* **Process Management:** Design and establish new processes, systems, or operating models required to implement approved eCommerce changes and improvements.
* **Progress \& Escalation:** Align regularly with the Manager Commercial Projects and Lead Product Owner on business case progress, challenges, dependencies, and impediments, escalating issues when research or deliverables fall behind schedule.
* **Change Management:** Support and drive business change within an agile environment, ensuring proposed changes are clearly understood, assessed, communicated, and aligned with business objectives.
* **Post\-Implementation Support:** Support Project Managers in assessing the performance and effectiveness of rolled\-out projects to ensure critical and efficient evaluation of eCommerce initiatives.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with teams across the Commercial Department, including Marketing, Content, B2B, Sales Channels, and Customer Service, to ensure proposed solutions address business needs across the eCommerce ecosystem.

 **You have:**

* **Experience:** 4–7 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, eCommerce, digital transformation, project/change management, or a related field.
* **Education:** University\-level education in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* **Business Analysis Expertise:** Strong understanding of business analysis processes, including requirements gathering, research, data analysis, solution assessment, business case development, and impact evaluation.
* **eCommerce Understanding:** Good understanding of eCommerce environments, business processes, digital platforms, technology solutions, and emerging industry trends.
* **Agile Experience:** Demonstrated track record of working in an agile organization and supporting or driving business and process changes in an agile environment.
* **Data \& Analytical Skills:** Strong data analysis, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data and research into actionable business recommendations.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to understand business objectives, evaluate multiple solution options, identify opportunities, and develop innovative solutions that deliver measurable business value.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and communicate recommendations to senior\-level management.
* **Communication \& Reporting:** Strong ability to prepare business reports, presentations, business cases, and management updates that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and expected business impact.
* **Decision\-Making:** Ability to assess diverse stakeholder inputs, analyze complex situations, evaluate implications, and select appropriate plans of action.
* **Project \& Change Management:** Understanding of project scope, resource planning, budget forecasting, change requests, and change management processes.
* **Technical Skills:** Ability to quickly learn and work with new systems, software, eCommerce platforms, analytical tools, and emerging technologies.
* **Research Skills:** Ability to independently conduct market research, competitor analysis, surveys, workshops, and other forms of business research.
* **Collaboration:** Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across interdisciplinary and cross\-functional teams.
* **Independence:** Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced digital and eCommerce environment while managing multiple business cases simultaneously.
* **Language:** Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Key Competencies:** Problem\-solving, strategic planning, process improvement, data analysis, decision\-making, stakeholder management, teamwork, technical aptitude, reporting, and managerial capabilities.
